width.scope: finite-width synthetic classification experiment; coordinate stability is not a theorem of LR transfer

depth.objective: sequence-mean CE; every record has 4 supervised positions
depth.initialization: core standard Gaussian std=0.02 weights, zero biases; fixed sinusoidal position encoding
depth.norm_definition: LayerNorm affine gamma=1 beta=0, eps=1e-5; Pre-LN includes final LayerNorm
depth.scope: width fixed; residual rule means alpha=1 or 1/sqrt(2*depth); 4 updates on the same eight training sequences
depth.paper_scope: Xiong theorem uses single-head, dxd matrices, zero Q/K and Gaussian inputs; this core differs and does not test a universal no-warmup claim

probes.gradient_definition: d(sequence-mean CE)/d(parameter or hidden); RMS per tensor element
